context: Evaluates the use of the Splitpanes library to build an adaptive two-level split layout. The sidebar must switch between a single NavPanel and a nested two-panel Splitpanes depending on whether rightPanel is non-null, and the correct size constraints and dark-theme class bindings must be applied.

checklist.name: Splitpanes + Pane import
checklist.description: Splitpanes and Pane are imported from 'splitpanes' and used as the layout components for both the outer and inner splits.

checklist.name: Sidebar pane constraints
checklist.description: The sidebar Pane has size=25, min-size=10, and max-size=60 props set correctly.

checklist.name: Conditional nested splitpanes
checklist.description: A v-if / v-else (or template v-if) conditional renders a single NavPanel when rightPanel is null/falsy, and a nested Splitpanes with two NavPanel panes when rightPanel is present.

checklist.name: Inner pane constraints
checklist.description: Each of the two inner Pane components inside the nested Splitpanes has min-size=20 and max-size=80.

checklist.name: Dark theme class binding
checklist.description: A conditional CSS class (e.g. 'split-dark') is bound to the Splitpanes component(s) when currentTheme === 'dark'.

checklist.name: Main content pane min-size
checklist.description: The main content Pane (right of the sidebar) has min-size=40 to prevent it from being collapsed too small.
